scope: Retain saved/submitted draft image bytes on removal; preserve full OCR in follow-up history

newCases: 16000-character OCR response accepted unchanged; oversized OCR rejected
32001-character history entry accepted unchanged; oversized entry and more than 20 entries rejected
saved image removed then closed without save restores on reopen
saved image removed then save fails before commit restores on reopen
new image survives removal after server commit with lost response
never-submitted image is still deleted on removal
16000-character OCR plus 2000-character clarification survives save/reopen and real main request validator

limitations: Actual Electron renderer with fixture IPC/stores; no production OCR quality claim.
Previously persisted or submitted images are retained locally; automatic cleanup is not implemented.
